## Runs 6–7 — raw SdH checks and the fan design gate

Both sweeps completed: electron +3.2 and hole −1.2 ×10¹² cm⁻², calibrated D≈0, sr1 = B_1−B_2. Drain current remains 9.81–9.94 nA; |gate currents| <0.22 nA; sample 1.165–1.292 K; no 5 kΩ-range clipping. Raw signed Rxx is shown before FFTs. Electron candidate peaks around 7.3, 14.8, 22.3 and 29.4 T form a possible harmonic comb; these are candidates, not four pockets. The 29–30 T feature versus nominal F_L=33.09 T needs the global scale, density trajectory and sum-tone tests before classification. The hole candidates near 4–7 T merge as the FFT cutoff rises, consistent with the investigation's low-density resolution limitation. No stacking verdict yet.

`sdh_onset` reports an electron onset of 0.30 T **censored at the analysis boundary**. Run 6 used 50 mT steps below 1 T, which do not Nyquist-sample F_L there. Restricting to the adequately sampled B≥1 T record still yields a censored onset. Thus 0.30 T is not a measured onset and must not price a long fan. Per `landau-fan` cost-floor check, acquire the cheap low-field extension at the shared electron density first, with an independent inverse-B grid; retain run 6 for the high-field record. Hole onset is 0.71 T, but its accessible density is below the investigation's discriminating high-density window. Electron fan remains the chosen direction.

Timing calibration: run 6 120.31 min for 921 points / 10 T; run 7 95.63 min for 486 points / 9.7 T. Subtracting the 0.137 T/min ramp floor leaves ≈3.08 s per point (driver 3 s settle included). The spot-check record is positive-field only; odd-in-B contamination is untested. Gate-map ridge multiplicity remains a spatial-density confound, not established mixed stacking.

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, plot_raw, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
for fid in (6,7):
    r=open_run(f'data/{fid}')
    plot_raw(r)
    plt.show()
    cs=resolve_channels(r.meta); ci=current_channel(cs); cv=next(c for c in cs if c.cid=='sr1')
    R=(r.col(cv.col)/cv.gain)/(r.col(ci.col)/ci.gain)
    B=r.col('magnet_field')
    print(f'run {fid}:', sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000).summary())
    if fid==6:
        print('Adequately sampled portion:',sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=1,r_full_scale=5000).summary())
    fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13,3.5))
    for ax,low in zip(axs,(1,1.5,2)):
        for degree in (3,5,7):
            f,sp=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(low,10),bg_degree=degree,log=False,nfft=4096)
            ax.plot(f,sp[0]/max(sp[0]),label=f'degree {degree}')
        ax.set(xlim=(0,65),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='Normalized FFT',title=f'run {fid}: B {low}–10 T')
        ax.legend()
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — resolve the censored onset before the Landau fan

> **05:21** · SdH onset prerequisite for fan: n=+3.2e12, D=0; B 0.2-1.5 T, 435 inverse-B points; 10 nA, base T · **ETA ~06:01** (≈40 min)

`landau-fan` step 1 requires the measured `sdh_onset` rather than an assumed low-field floor. Run 6's result is censored at 0.30 T and remains censored when restricted to its properly sampled B≥1 T segment (ana runs 6–7); its coarse 50 mT low-field sampling cannot resolve F_L=33.09 T. This `sdh-spot-check` extension at the same n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D≈0 replaces that low-field sampling and changes the grid to test aliasing. The subsequent fan will use the resulting onset, restrict density to the discriminating electron region, and compare its shared n=3.2 column against run 6.

435 points uniform in 1/B, 0.2→1.5 T: Δ(1/B)=0.009985 T⁻¹, 3.03 samples per nominal F_L period. This is a fundamental-frequency onset check; harmonics above 50 T are not resolved here. Preserve 10 nA, sr1 50 µV, τ=0.3 s / 24 dB and the driver's 3 s settle (10τ); do not change gate pacing. Gate voltages (+0.98362,+1.16612) V stay within SAFETIES. Field cost: 0→1.5 T at 0.137 T/min =10.95 min plus 435×3.08 s (runs 6/7) =22.33 min; allow thermometry, gate positioning and overhead margin. Finish at 1.5 T and the shared electron point.

Preconditions print and assert base T/fresh thermometry, heaters off, PS/output on, Si 0/RNGE 2/output on, drive/filter/NPLC, wiring and exact card validators; initial B must match the handoff zero. Check first 20 points and halfway for leakage, clipping, current continuity and temperature; stop on guard failure. The VTI supply continues toward its last target after a kernel interrupt; only the operator can abort a field ramp at the supply. No stacking classification follows from this extension alone.

# Read-only preconditions; no validators or operating limits are changed.
for label, candidates in [('T_sample',VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample']),('T_vaporizer',VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_vaporizer'])]:
    assert_thermometry_live(label,candidates,max_age=15,max_period=12)
_ts,_tv,_b=T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field()
print(f'Expected base 1.0–1.5 K, vaporizer <1.6 K, Si 0 V; actual {_ts:.3f}, {_tv:.3f} K, Si {k_si():.4f} V; B {_b:.5f} T')
assert 1.0<=_ts<=1.5 and _tv<1.6 and abs(_tv-_ts)<0.6 and abs(k_si())<0.01
print('Expected heaters off, magnet PS/output on:',heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range(),magnet.persistent_switch_on(),magnet.output_enabled())
assert heater.sample_range()==0 and heater.vaporizer_range()==0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
for par, expected in [(k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),(dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),(magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),(heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    actual=(float(par.vals._min_value),float(par.vals._max_value))
    print(par.full_name,'validator expected',expected,'actual',actual)
    assert actual==expected
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10. and T_SESSION_CAP==100.
print('Expected drive 1 V / 13.777 Hz, tau 0.3 s / slope 24, NPLC 1:',sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency(),sr0.time_constant(),sr1.time_constant(),sr0.filter_slope(),sr1.filter_slope(),k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
assert abs(sr1.amplitude()-1)<1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777)<0.01
assert sr0.time_constant()==0.3 and sr1.time_constant()==0.3
assert sr0.filter_slope()==24 and sr1.filter_slope()==24
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
assert k_tg.volt.step==0.005 and k_bg.volt.step==0.005
assert dc205.ramp_rate==0.5 and dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1
assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
assert abs(_b)<0.02, 'handoff field expected 0 T'
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
CAL=dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-0.0894,D_offset=-0.013)
vt,vb=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0.,**CAL)
assert -0.3<=vt<=1. and -1.3<=vb<=2.
B_vec=field_invB(0.2,1.5,435)
assert np.max(np.abs(np.diff(1/B_vec)))<=0.01
# Fixed 50 uV inherited from run 6, 5 kohm full scale; 3 s driver dwell = 10 tau.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
assert magnet.settle_s>=3. and sr0.sensitivity()==0.02
mc=dict(meas_config)
mc.update({'Si (V)':k_si(),'sample_temperature:':_ts,'comments':'sdh-spot-check onset extension: n=+3.2e12 cm^-2 D=0, B 0.2->1.5 T inverse-B 435 points; run-5 CAL; sr1 50uV, 10nA; no Si move'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(mc['comments'])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,vb); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,vt)
interruptible_sleep(10)
for p in (T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P):
    s.fp(p); s.plot('time',p)
# [time,B,Ts,Tv,Itg,Ibg,sr0X,sr0P,sr1X,sr1P]
def onset_guard(station,data):
    d=np.asarray(data,dtype=float)
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(d)) or abs(d[4])>1e-9 or abs(d[5])>1e-9 or not 1.0<=d[2]<=1.5 or d[3]>=1.6 or abs(d[8])>=0.9*50e-6 or not 8e-9<d[6]/-1e6<12e-9:
        print('ONSET EXTENSION STOP: data guard',d)
        station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(onset_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0)
print('Extension endpoint:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),T_sample())
